name: DAYLIGHT DONUTS

violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. -Scoop handles were in product in spice bins.
Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Test strip or kit that accurately measures the sanitizing concentration was not provided. -Test strips for chlorine are damaged and need replaced.
Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. -3 compartment sink drain pipe is leaking

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. -Keep paper towels visible and readily accessible at all times.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. -Cardboard on back racks need to be removed. -Pallets for storage need to be painted or clear stained. -Do not reuse cardboard boxes for donut delivery.
